context: A mom helps her young son think through a confusing day
purpose: Teach: そいつ/先程/予め/不完全/つかむ/加わる/おこなわ/聞かさ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ翔、先程からずっと黙ってるけど、学校で何かあったの?
lines.en: Hey Sho, you've been quiet for a while now — did something happen at school?
lines.style: Gentle motherly probing with soft concern in her voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…なんか、今日の話し合い、不完全な感じで終わっちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah... the discussion today kind of ended in an incomplete way.
lines.style: Hesitant young boy voice trailing off in thought

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そいつは気になるね。話し合いって、どんなテーマでおこなわれたの?
lines.en: That sounds frustrating. What kind of topic was the discussion conducted on?
lines.style: Warm engaged tone inviting him to keep talking further

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: クラスのルール決め。途中から議論に加わるのは難しくて、みんなの意見ばっかり聞かされて、自分の考えを言えなかった。
lines.en: Deciding class rules. Joining the debate partway through is hard — I just kept hearing everyone else's opinions and couldn't share mine.
lines.style: Frustrated child explaining a complicated social situation honestly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: なるほどね。次は予め言いたいことをメモしておくと、話すタイミングをつかむのが楽になるかもよ。
lines.en: I see. Next time, if you jot down what you want to say in advance, it might be easier to grab the right moment to speak.
lines.style: Practical maternal advice delivered with quiet confidence and warmth

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メモか…そっか、それなら手を挙げるきっかけもつかめそう。
lines.en: A memo, huh... yeah, that might give me a cue to raise my hand too.
lines.style: Brightening young voice as an idea clicks into place

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: でしょ? 翔の意見もちゃんと大事だから、自信持って入っていこうね。
lines.en: Right? Your opinion matters too, so go in there with confidence next time.
lines.style: Encouraging affectionate close from a supportive loving parent
